answer_1.quote: Text generation. The scene description is generated from the selected story triplets in question selection phase and using a publicly available context-free grammar (CFG) provided in SPARTQA-AUTO. However, we increase the variety of spatial expressions by using a vocabulary of various entity properties and relation expressions... For the question text, we generate the entity description and relation expression for each question triplet.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the models, we measure the accuracy which is the percentage of correct predictions in the test sets. ... We use Macro F1-score (mean of F1 for all classes) to evaluate the performance of the SRol and SRel models.
